description: Modern multi-page or single-page static websites. Pure HTML/CSS/JS served by nginx. Portable — download and host anywhere.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a portfolio site, landing page, restaurant website, or company brochure
ui.description: Pure HTML/CSS/JS served by nginx:alpine. Choose a CSS framework. Download and host anywhere.

sample_prompts: A portfolio website for a photographer with a gallery grid and contact form
A restaurant landing page with menu, hours, location map, and reservation link
A startup landing page with hero section, feature cards, pricing, and CTA
kit_prompt_prefix: Build a modern, responsive static website using HTML and CSS.

user_inputs.label: CSS Framework
user_inputs.hint: Choose a CSS framework for styling
